function.description: Retrieves a list of CLI templates attached to a network profile based on the network profile ID.
function.name: api_retrieveCLITemplatesAttachedToANetworkProfile

profileId.description: The `id` of the network profile, retrievable from `GET /intent/api/v1/networkProfilesForSites`

id.description: The id of the template attached to the site profile - `/intent/api/v1/templates`

name.description: The name of the template attached to the site profile - `/intent/api/v1/templates`
